title: Closed waters
schema_notes: Each closure is one sub-paragraph (e.g. (3)(B) = Sheep Bay).
Coords use the regulation's DMS format: 'DD MM.MM N|S' for lat, 'DDD MM.MM E|W' for lon.
scope.feature: name of the bay/inlet the closure sits in (used to look up a polygon scope).
scope.district: parent district (always set; used as fallback scope).
scope.feature_buffer_km: optional explicit radius around the gazetteer centroid when no bbox exists.
ops: list of operations producing geometry. combined per `combine`.
half_plane: {op, side: north|south|east|west, line: [[lat,lon],[lat,lon]]} -- closed area is on `side` of line.
polyline_split: same as half_plane but the line is multi-segment. Splits district along polyline, keeps `side`.
whole_feature: {op, feature: <name>} -- the entire named feature polygon is closed.
buffer_streams: {op, radius_yards, filter?} -- buffers all AWC stream-mouth points in scope (and matching filter).
buffer_points: {op, radius_yards, points: [[lat,lon],...]} -- buffers explicit terminus points.
custom_polygon: {op, ring: [[lat,lon],...]} -- a hand-traced closed ring.
combine: union (default) | intersection. Compound 'south of LAT and east of LON' closures use intersection.
exception: regulation id whose EO can override this closure (e.g. '5AAC24.361(b)').
review_notes: anything the reviewer should know — interpretive choices, PDF cross-checks, AWC dependencies.
